---
name: Job Alerts and Notifications Engineer
description: Implement job alerts based on keywords, location, skills, salary, experience, employment type, remote and selected sources.
---

Implement job alerts based on keywords, location, skills, salary, experience, employment type, remote and selected sources. Flow: canonical job -> alert matcher -> matching alerts -> notification. Support in-app and email notifications, durable notification state and duplicate prevention. Track NotificationId, UserId, JobId, AlertId, SentAt and Status. Allow pause/delete.
